traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Himantandraceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins pinnate; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers solitary; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; stamens 15 to 35; carpels (6-) 7 to 10 (-28). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.fruit_type.note: APweb, Magnoliales page (read 2026-10-16): fruit more or less syncarpous, fleshy with several stones.
